rules.statement: V completed Padre's gig "Bring Me the Head of Gustavo Orta" on the branch where Padre's debrief treated Gustavo Orta as dead; the record does not prove who killed him or how.
V knocked Gustavo Orta unconscious and put him in the trunk of Padre's car; Padre's debrief acknowledged receiving him alive.
Karubo Bairei was killed during Padre's gig "Old Friends", and Padre closed the contract on the kill.
V took Karubo Bairei down without killing him and loaded him into Padre's transport; Padre's debrief said he would deal with Karubo himself.
In "Old Friends" V completed the optional objective of neutralizing Karubo without raising the alarm.
In "Old Friends" the bar's alarm was raised, so the optional silent-takedown objective was lost.
Tucker Albach was killed in Padre's gig "Eye for an Eye"; Padre's debrief was the kill variant.
V knocked Tucker Albach unconscious and delivered him to Padre's car; Padre said he would make sure Tucker answered for his sins.
V let Tucker Albach go free in "Eye for an Eye"; Padre's debrief scolded V that a sinner's fate was not V's to decide.
V completed Padre's gig "On a Tight Leash" on the branch where Padre's debrief treated José Luis as dead; the record does not prove that he actually died.
V knocked José Luis unconscious and carried him to Padre's transport in "On a Tight Leash".

After examining the depot computer, V told Padre on the call that Arasaka was behind José Luis's protection and that the gang was being outfitted with Militech gear; Padre speculated it was cover for a corporate war.
V recovered the daemon-infected shard from Jim Greyer's body and deposited it at Padre's drop point, completing "Jeopardy".
V stole Kerry Eurodyne's guitar from the fan's apartment and deposited it at Padre's drop point, completing "Psychofan".
V stole the data on Javier Alvarado's embezzlement for Padre ("Fifth Column"); Padre texted "Data received."
V took the scandium rods from El Gallo's workshop and deposited them at Padre's drop point ("Going Up or Down?").
V recovered Jake Estevez's custom car from the Valentinos' garage and delivered it back to Jake, completing Padre's gig "Life's Work".
V took the Militech SUV back from the Valentinos and delivered it to the nomad buyers for Padre ("The Lord Giveth and Taketh Away").
V stole the compromising material from Sr. Ladrillo's office in the Dicky Twister for Padre ("Sr. Ladrillo's Private Collection").
In the Street Kid prologue, Padre met V and gave V a ride in his car to Embers.
V attended Jackie Welles's ofrenda at El Coyote Cojo and spoke with Padre there.
After V finished all of Padre's Heywood contracts, Padre messaged V offering a car (the Seraph) as thanks ("God Bless This Mess").
V installed the malware on the servers in garage 66 for Muamar's gig "Error 404".
V got the documents incriminating Matheus Stove from the Kendachi factory for Muamar ("Race to the Top"); Muamar texted that he had received them.
V recovered the stolen beta acid container and deposited it at Muamar's drop point ("Serious Side Effects").
V searched Booker Updike's motel room 103 and worked out what happened to him; Muamar's debrief gave V bonus points for solving the mystery of Booker's fate.
V planted Ted Fox's tracker on the Kendachi truck for Muamar's gig "Breaking News".
In "Breaking News" V completed the optional objective to remain undetected; Muamar's debrief praised a tip-top op.
In "Breaking News" V was detected, failing the optional objective to remain undetected.
V retrieved the Zetatech datashard Juliet Horrigan owed Muamar and deposited it at his drop point ("Family Matters").
V found out what happened to Juliet Horrigan; in the debrief Muamar reacted with shock that Juliet had been killed by a sister she had never mentioned.
V uploaded the virus onto the 6th Street netrunner's computer for Muamar ("Hacking the Hacker").
V killed Lucius Thoran during "Hacking the Hacker"; Muamar's debrief called it the cherry on top.
V retrieved Rihanna Kumar's Cytech research files and transferred them to Muamar ("Severance Package"); Muamar texted that the data was received.
V stole the automated Zetatech car with Pedro and left it at Tirempire as agreed, completing Muamar's gig "Desperate Measures".
V completed Muamar's gig "For My Son" on the branch where Muamar's debrief treated Logan Garcia as dead; the record does not prove that he actually died.
V put Logan Garcia in the trunk for Muamar alive; Muamar's debrief said Logan was on his way to him, tied up.
After V asked Muamar about David Martinez, Martinez's crew (Falco) got in touch with V, and Muamar texted that someone had left V a package with him.
V picked up the gift Martinez's crew left with Muamar: David Martinez's jacket.
V recovered the Porsche 911 that vanished with its seller and texted Muamar it was back and still running (the seller was dead); Muamar replied that at least he wouldn't want it back.
After V finished Muamar's Santo Domingo gigs, Muamar messaged V offering a car (the Bloody Maria) as thanks ("Ride Captain Ride").
V got the Arasaka truck off the cargo ship and delivered it to Muamar's garage, completing "Baby Let Me Take You".
The Arasaka truck was destroyed during "Baby Let Me Take You"; Muamar texted that V had blown the job.
V went back to help Daniels at the docks and he survived; Muamar later confirmed Daniels was alive but angry about the lost gear.
V left Daniels behind at the docks to protect the cargo; Muamar later told V that Daniels was dead.
V stole Vortex's credchip from the Tyger Claws' casino and deposited it at Wakako's drop point ("Tyger and Vulture").
V found Leah Gladen's CorpCracker lockbreaker and deposited it at Wakako's drop point ("Greed Never Pays").
V stole the shard with Emilio Gutierrez's depository receipts and deposited it at Wakako's drop point ("Until Death Do Us Part").
In "Until Death Do Us Part" V completed the optional objective to remain undetected; Wakako's debrief praised the discretion.
In "Until Death Do Us Part" V raised the alarm, failing the optional objective to remain undetected.
V planted Wakako's wiretap inside the main hall of the Tyger Claw-controlled shrine ("A Shrine Defiled").
In "A Shrine Defiled" V completed the optional objective to remain undetected; Wakako said V came and went like a ghost.
In "A Shrine Defiled" V was detected, failing the optional objective to remain undetected.
V drove Sergei's car to the Tyger Claws' diner and handed over the "gift" with Alex in the trunk, completing Wakako's gig "Olive Branch".
V safely disconnected 8ug8ear and carried her to Wakako's car, completing the rescue in "Getting Warmer...".
8ug8ear died during "Getting Warmer..." and the gig failed; Wakako's debrief told V that V had let the target die.
In "Down on the Street", Wakako gave V the intel on Arasaka's parade through Japantown: the district sealed off and the dashi platforms flying overhead.
Wakako paid V the fee for the Sandra Dorsett rescue job ("The Gig").
After V completed all of Wakako's Westbrook contracts, Wakako messaged V offering a car (the Byakko) as thanks ("Professional Widow").
V uploaded Dino's virus to the Empathy club's server ("A Lack of Empathy").
In "A Lack of Empathy" V completed the optional objective to avoid combat; Dino's debrief cheered the clean in-and-out job.
In "A Lack of Empathy" V got into combat at the club, failing the optional objective to avoid it.
V completed Dino's gig "An Inconvenient Killer" on the branch where Dino's debrief treated Jack Mausser as dead; the record does not prove that he actually died.
V knocked Jack Mausser out and loaded him into Dino's car alive; Dino's debrief said "Preem work".
In "An Inconvenient Killer" V completed the optional objective to avoid combat inside the 7th Hell club.
In "An Inconvenient Killer" combat broke out inside the 7th Hell club, failing the optional objective to avoid it.
V carried Joanne Koch alive to the nomads' AV on the hotel roof; Dino's debrief said she was on her way to a warm welcome.
V stole the CCTV footage from Memorial Park Station for Dino ("Serial Suicide"); Dino texted that he got the data.
V downloaded the Councilwoman Eva Cole recordings at the docks and sent them to Dino ("The Frolics of Councilwoman Cole"); Dino texted that he got the files.
In "The Frolics of Councilwoman Cole" V completed the optional objective to remain undetected.
In "The Frolics of Councilwoman Cole" V was detected, failing the optional objective to remain undetected.
After V took every City Center gig Dino had, Dino messaged V offering the Quadra Type-66 "BULLIT" as thanks ("Gas Gas Gas").
